markdown_line: Do not use Markdown syntax in user-facing replies (no headings like ###, no **bold**, no backticks, no markdown links).
purpose: WEB_SUBAGENT_PLAN §16.1 (R2, 2026-09-17): the one reviewed reply-policy line of the main prompt, REVERSED on the candidate before r7 (r5's/r7's shape) because the r5 rule pins body templates that carry the main prompt (automatic-protected-0, exhausted-protected-0, estimated-0, exhausted-after-prune-0, large-reasoning-0) and a forward edit of the reference could never reach them. Exactly the named captures — every candidate request that carries the main prompt's reply-style section: main-agent turns, messaging-style subagent runs and the two r5-only requests; loop-exhausted-1 exists only in the pinned-SOURCE reference (the candidate answers that scenario with one request since r4) — carry the line once, right after the Markdown line, and lose it as a raw byte edit; the 3 summarizer captures carry no reply-style section and must stay byte-identical. The lifecycle driver has no web search key, so no tool schema and no web bullet changes here (§4.9).
reply_policy_line: When the user asked you to find something concrete (a product, a place, a service, a document, an offer), give each item's link or location next to its name when available — the one bare URL or address that lets the user act on it, not a list of sources — and say when it could not be established; never guess a URL or an address. Don't add unnecessary links, and keep the message short.
